articles.title: Publisher's Platform: They stopped counting, and now they say they can’t see
articles.description: If you want to make foodborne disease disappear, don’t investigate foodborne disease. That’s not a slippery-slope warning anymore. As of July 1, 2025, it’s the operating plan.
